summary: Iteration 25: Store name fix, Privacy/Support pages and Report a Problem. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (tests/test_nocturne_iter25_support_privacy.py, -n 0). Covered: public /api/legal/privacy and /api/legal/support (200 text/html, all required sections, the FAQ links to /api/legal/privacy); POST /api/support/reports (201 for all 6 categories, message trimmed, user name/email filled in, no _id; 422 for a bad category, a message under 5 or over 2000 chars, or context over 80 chars; 401 without auth; 429 on the 11th report in the same hour); /mine returns only the caller's own reports; admin list with open/resolved/all filters; PUT to resolve and reopen (resolved_at set, then cleared); non-admin gets 403, unknown id gets 404, a bad status gets 422. Push was tested in-process with send_push monkeypatched: admins get exactly one push (key report-<id>, url /admin/reports) and the member gets one on resolve (key report-done-<id>, url /support). app.json name is 'Nocturne' with slug 'frontend' unchanged. payout-settings shows 'Payouts sent by our team' and no 'Coming soon'. Frontend (390x844): all flows passed with no page errors. Sign-up legal line and both links open the hosted pages in a new tab. On Profile, 'Help & support' goes to /support and 'Privacy policy' opens the privacy page. On /support: Send is disabled for empty or 4-char input, the category chip selects, submit shows report-sent and clears the input, and 'Your reports' shows the report with an OPEN pill. Both external links open correctly. The concierge flag button opens /support?context=concierge with 'Concierge chat' preselected, the report is saved with context 'concierge', and back returns to /concierge. Admin: 'Problem reports' row goes to /admin/reports, cards show category, context, user and date, and Mark resolved / Reopen moves cards between the Open and Resolved tabs. The member then sees status resolved. Only minor issues found. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

minor.issue: min_length=5 is checked on the raw message before .strip(). A message of 6 spaces (or '    a') passes validation and is saved as '' or 'a'. Validate the trimmed length, e.g. with a field_validator that strips first and then checks len >= 5. The UI trims, so only direct API callers are affected.
The rate-limit window starts at the top of the clock hour, not a rolling 60 minutes. A user can send 10 at 10:59 and 10 more at 11:00. Acceptable, but use now - 1h if a rolling limit is intended.

issues: The 'Problem reports' row (admin-reports-btn) is only 37px tall, under the 44px minimum. The shared listRow style uses paddingVertical: spacing.sm; add minHeight: 44 (this affects all admin list rows).
signup-privacy-link and signup-support-link are inline Text links about 16px tall, which is a small touch target. Consider adding hitSlop (not supported on Text) or padding them as Pressable links.

action_items: (minor) In support.py ReportIn, validate the stripped message length so whitespace-only or short padded messages get 422.
(minor) Add minHeight: 44 to listRow in app/admin/index.tsx.
(optional) Make the rate limit a rolling 60-minute window if intended.
critical_code_review_comments: support.tsx: useLocalSearchParams context may be string | string[]. It is passed straight to the API as context, and an array would give 422. This is low risk because only the concierge link sets it.
Privacy page 'Last updated' is a hard-coded constant (UPDATED='June 2026'). Remember to bump it when the policy changes.
support.py notify() is fire-and-forget and does not block the request, which is correct. Admin pushes honour push_prefs.updates opt-out.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ users (test_i25_*, test_i25ui_*) and their support_reports were created and then deleted by id. support_reports is back to 0 docs and seeded accounts were untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_nocturne_iter25_support_privacy.py -n 0. Push is tested in-process by patching routes.push.send_push and draining push._tasks via conftest.run. The system clock is Nov 2026.
